autostart.title: Start with Windows

openLeague.title: Open League with Xyra
openLeague.description: Opening Xyra opens League too, so one icon opens both.

recordScreenshots.title: Save screenshots when cards are detected
recordScreenshots.description: To report bugs or calibrate other resolutions.

noProfile: Open League to load your profile.
dataDeleted: Done: your games, profile, screenshots and log were deleted.
connections: It only connects to OP.GG, CommunityDragon, GitHub (to look for a new version) and your League client.

securityRules.memory: Never reads or writes game memory.
securityRules.injection: Never injects into the game or opens its process.
securityRules.input: It does not simulate keys or clicks, and it does not play for you.
securityRules.hiddenInfo: Never reveals hidden information: only public OP.GG data.
securityRules.overlay: Only reads the screen and draws on top, like OBS or Discord.

securityNote: To show over the game, League must be in Borderless mode. While you play, Xyra never takes focus or receives clicks.

phone.title: Xyra on your phone

toggle.title: Phone link
toggle.description: Xyra opens an access point on your network so your phone sees the same as the window. It only uses memory while it is on.

phone.sameNetwork: Your phone has to be on the same Wi-Fi as your PC, or both on your Tailscale.
phone.firewall: When you turn the link on, Xyra prepares Windows: it marks your network as private and opens only its port. Windows will ask for administrator approval.
phone.canDo: From the app you can accept the match, follow champion select, see the build, the meta and your stats, and import runes, items and spells.
phone.private: Nobody can use it without the QR code, and nothing goes through the internet: the phone talks straight to your PC.
phone.off: Turn the link on to see the QR code.
phone.scan: Scan it with the Xyra app on your phone.
phone.qrAlt: QR code to open Xyra on your phone
phone.newCodeHint: Phones already connected stay connected; to remove one, disconnect it below.
phone.getApp: Install the Xyra app for Android from the Xyra downloads.
phone.prepared: Done: Windows now lets the app in on your private network.

devices.title: Connected phones
devices.none: No phones yet. Scan the code with the Xyra app to connect the first one.
devices.hint: Every phone can see your game, builds and stats; permissions decide what else it can do. A disconnected phone has to scan the code again.
